create.title: Cellwise phase-removed beta terminal-symbol normalization
create.statement_tex: On c'=5/4 freeze one actual terminal cell (j,h,q,x,beta,sign), with lambda=pi q sqrt(Xx)/D_j. The already summed limiting endpoint-free vector has no single lambda. Split the singular u^(-1) hard-top share from the smooth top remainder and all interior W_j shares. Only on the singular share, after the top delta and constant-numerator PV/log term are removed together, put A(L)=-1-b/2-i(L+beta), D(L,nu)=A(L)+i(L-nu)/2, and R_A[H]=-iH(L,L)/(2AD)+[H(L,nu)-H(L,L)]/[(L-nu)D]. At fixed physical nu its exact derivative is -i Hdot_0/(2AD)+H_0/(2A^2D)+H_0/(4AD^2)+[partial_L H-Hdot_0]/[(L-nu)D]-[H-H_0]/[(L-nu)^2D]+i[H-H_0]/[2(L-nu)D^2], where Hdot_0=(partial_L+partial_nu)H(L,L). Smooth shares retain their ordinary mu integral. The original three contour measures leave (2pi)^(-2) after the top distribution. Remove the full stationary phase before differentiating, and keep chi_4(q), the stationary numerator (D_j/q)lambda, the real h,D_j,x monomial, contour factors, radial integration, floors, stars, and external X^(1/4) outside the pre-numerator symbol. Exact Morse localization is a leading incomplete-Fresnel term plus a normalized varying-amplitude remainder, not a scalar multiplier. This is an exact normalization and derivative reduction, not a symbol estimate.
create.next_action: Use this normalization only cellwise. Prove the mixed norm for the complete phase-removed second translation divided difference and moving traces; do not attach one lambda to the aggregate vector.

create.title: Conditional summation of the cellwise beta saddle symbol
create.statement_tex: Let r=5/4-(a+b)/2 in (1,2). Assume on every phase-removed signed saddle/entry/exit cell the complete mixed physical-height norm, including moving regular traces and the exact normalized Morse remainder, is O_epsilon(X^epsilon lambda^(-2)). After multiplication by the exact stationary numerator, the retained coefficient before the external X^(1/4) factor is |chi_4(q)|h^(-r)q^(-2)D_j^(2-r)X^(r/2-1/2+b/4)x^(-r/2-b/2-5/4). Radial integration contributes min(1,[sqrt(X)|2 minus-or-plus q/D_j|]^(-1)); its q-sum is O(X^(-1/2)log(2X)). The formal resonance q=2D_j is even and vanishes under chi_4, and the nearest nonzero odd term is O((D_j sqrt(X))^(-1)). The h-sum and all actual dyadic scales are therefore polylogarithmic internally, and restoring the external normalization gives O_epsilon(X^(1/4+epsilon)) for this complete large-alpha saddle package. This is a conditional implication only; it does not prove the mixed symbol hypothesis, bounded-alpha or double-bounded shares, or the complete beta transition.
create.next_action: Invoke this implication only after the cellwise mixed symbol norm and its exact Morse remainder are proved; do not use it for bounded-alpha or double-bounded cells.

update.statement_tex: Let I_(U,V)(L)=[-V,V] intersect [L-U,L+U] and R(L)=int_(I_(U,V)(L))K(L,nu)dnu on a signed cell I_lambda of length O(lambda). The earlier factorized hypothesis |K|<=M lambda^(-2)w, |partial_L K|<=M lambda^(-3)w, with the same L1 weight on moving traces, remains sufficient. More generally and directly, it is enough that sup_(L in I_lambda)int|K(L,nu)|dnu + int_(I_lambda)int|partial_L K(L,nu)|dnu dL + sum_gamma int_(I_lambda)|K(L,gamma(L))|dL <= M lambda^(-2), where gamma ranges over the affine moving faces. Then ||R||_infinity+Var_(I_lambda)R=O(M lambda^(-2)). This is the physical-height Leibniz lemma; it neither controls an oscillatory stationary phase nor supplies the exact Morse remainder needed before K is formed.
update.next_action: Apply the direct mixed-norm form only after the complete cellwise phase-removed kernel, its moving traces, and the separate exact Morse remainder have been controlled.

update.title: Cellwise phase-removed axial-subtracted beta mixed symbol bound
update.statement_tex: At c'=5/4, after the proved endpoint, side, arithmetic, artificial, axial, collision, connector, and corner ownership operations, freeze one actual cell (j,h,q,x,beta,sign) and lambda=pi q sqrt(Xx)/D_j. Use M9-M1-beta-cellwise-phase-removed-symbol-reduction: split the singular hard-top Plemelj regularizer from all smooth ordinary-mu shares; remove the complete stationary phase; and keep the character, stationary numerator (D_j/q)lambda, exact real coefficient monomial, contour constants, radial integration, floors, stars, and external X^(1/4) outside. Prove uniformly that sup_L int|K(L,nu)|dnu + int int|partial_L K(L,nu)|dnu dL + sum_gamma int|K(L,gamma(L))|dL + R_Morse(K) <<_epsilon X^epsilon lambda^(-2), where partial_L fixes physical nu, gamma includes every moving regular face, and R_Morse is the exact normalized varying-amplitude Morse remainder with its endpoint traces. For the singular share the first open coefficient is E_H=[partial_L H(L,nu)-(partial_L+partial_nu)H(L,L)]/(L-nu)-[H(L,nu)-H(L,L)]/(L-nu)^2, with complete entry/exit, beta-connector, and common-ownership factors. Smooth shares retain ordinary mu integration and may use an X-truncated harmonic height weight of polylogarithmic L1 norm. No single-lambda bound is asserted for the already summed limiting vector.
update.next_action: Expand the complete phase-removed hard-top numerator and prove the mixed norm for E_H and every moving trace through both saddle signs and entry/exit. Treat smooth shares separately and reuse the already closed conditional coefficient sum.

update.statement_tex: The all-strata aggregate pointwise-symbol formulation is rejected. Boundary, side, endpoint, arithmetic, artificial, axial, collision, connector, corner, and global-height interfaces are already routed through their proved modules. The remaining quantitative terminal interface is exactly the cellwise phase-removed mixed symbol obligation M9-M1-beta-axial-subtracted-terminal-symbol-bound, followed by the proved physical-height finite-section BV lemma and M9-M1-beta-cellwise-symbol-sum-reduction. This compositional formulation retains singular hard-top and smooth ordinary-mu shares separately and makes no single-lambda assertion for the limiting aggregate. Bounded-alpha, double-bounded, and complete beta-transition assembly remain separate obligations.
update.next_action: Prove the corrected cellwise mixed symbol norm, then compose it with the finite-section and conditional summation reductions; do not revive an all-inclusive aggregate pointwise kernel.

update.statement_tex: After removing the explicit delta jumps and q^(-4) height-face logs, the separated fixed-b R1 kernel has the target local norm. For the complete regular beta finite part, use the proved boundary-first and axial ownership modules, the exact cellwise phase-removed normalization, and the direct mixed physical-height BV lemma. The sole quantitative terminal input is M9-M1-beta-axial-subtracted-terminal-symbol-bound; the large-alpha coefficient and resonance sums are then supplied by M9-M1-beta-cellwise-symbol-sum-reduction. The singular hard-top divided difference and every smooth ordinary-mu share remain distinct, and all phase, stationary numerator, h,D_j,x, contour, floor, star, character, and external factors retain their declared ownership. Bounded-alpha and double-bounded assembly remain open.
update.next_action: Prove the complete second translation divided-difference mixed norm and Morse traces. The scale and exact-resonance summation no longer needs to be redone.

reject.reason: The limiting vector is summed over j,h,q and integrated over x, so lambda=pi q sqrt(Xx)/D_j varies inside it. The bare lambda symbol inequality is meaningful only after freezing and normalizing a cell.

Only the singular u^(-1) hard-top share produces the signed delta/PV regularizer. Smooth top remainders and interior W_j shares retain ordinary mu integration and cannot undergo a second top subtraction.

The top distribution consumes one of the three (2pi)^(-1) factors. The beta and nu measures leave (2pi)^(-2); omitting them makes an aggregate identity inexact even though it does not change exponents.
On saddle entry and exit, Psi'(L)=log(|L+beta|/lambda) is order one. Differentiating the oscillatory phase preserves lambda^(-2) rather than producing the required lambda^(-3).
Uniform Morse localization of a varying amplitude is an incomplete-Fresnel leading term plus an exact normalized remainder and moving traces, not an exact scalar factorization by the saddle value.
The downstream Leibniz argument only needs the mixed physical-height norm. Smooth translated ridges may instead use an actual-range truncated harmonic weight with polylogarithmic L1 cost.

Round 38 proves a fixed-X signed Cauchy limit with unrestricted X-dependent constants. It supplies neither the cellwise X^epsilon mixed norm nor the fixed-physical-height second divided-difference bound.
The summation ledger is conditional on the missing mixed symbol norm and covers the large-alpha saddle package. Bounded-alpha, double-bounded, and final transition assembly remain open.
